summary: Wrote a 4-phase sequential implementation plan for hardening test-four-tier-conflict.sh Case 1's releaser race. Phase 1 establishes an expected-RED non-vacuousness baseline against the unmodified file under the dispatch's induced-load harness; Phase 2 applies research's validated signal-file-gated releaser (PATH-shimmed bare sleep touches a marker, releaser polls it) in the single source-store file; Phase 3 re-runs the loaded A/B against the committed file; Phase 4 redeploys and runs the full gate set. Research arrived with a prototype already validated 3/3 under load, so no design uncertainty remained to plan around.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: RED baseline, signal-file fix, loaded A/B, redeploy plus full gate set.
